main_menu.welcome_text: Pick a language and tell us your name.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reset_confirm: All progress will be erased. Are you sure?
settings.about_text: Retro Village works fully offline. No ads, no login, no servers, no analytics. Your data stays on this device only. All code, visuals and sounds are original.
settings.name: Player name
settings.controls_hint: This changes how you walk around the village map.

common.exit_text: Your score in this run will not be saved.

map.pond_closed: The pond is closed for now.
map.hint: Drag the stick to walk. Tap A at doors and villagers.

goals.plant: Plant your first seed at the farm
goals.harvest: Wait for it to grow, then harvest it
goals.blocks: Visit the school and play Crystal Garden
goals.maze: Try Energy Maze at the arcade
goals.festival: Join your first festival in the square
goals.cafe: Save {coins} coins to open the café
goals.pond: Save {coins} coins to open the pond
goals.cave: Save {coins} coins to open the cave
goals.quests: Finish and claim your daily quests

home.name: Your House
home.desc: Decorate your room, change your outfit and check records.

farm.name: Garden Farm
farm.desc: Plant seeds, harvest crops and care for animals.

square.name: Village Square
square.desc: Join the Festival: three mini games, one big score.

arcade.name: Arcade Cabin
arcade.desc: Maze, eel pond, space, tower, road and sparrow.

school.name: Village School
school.desc: A crystal puzzle, a music lesson and a friendly teacher.

cafe.name: Village Café
cafe.desc: Serve drinks before guests lose patience.

shop.name: General Store
shop.desc: Seeds, decorations, outfits and village upgrades.

cave.name: Cave Entrance
cave.desc: A treasure run and a shaft climb.

pond.name: Pond
pond.desc: Calm fishing from a wooden pier.

maze.name: Energy Maze
maze.pitch: Collect energy shards and dodge patrol bots.
maze.how: Swipe or drag to turn. Grab every shard to clear the maze.

blocks.name: Crystal Garden
blocks.pitch: Fit garden crystals on the grid and clear lines.
blocks.how: Drag a piece onto the grid. Full rows and columns vanish.

shooter.name: Orbit Sweeper
shooter.pitch: Blast space junk with your little ship.
shooter.how: Drag to fly. Your ship fires by itself.

cave.name: Cave Gem Run
cave.pitch: Dash through the cave and grab the treasure.
cave.how: Tap to jump. Tap again in the air for a double jump.

cafe.name: Café Rush
cafe.pitch: Mix the right ingredients before guests leave.
cafe.how: Tap a guest, then tap ingredients in the order shown.

snake.name: Snake Garden
snake.pitch: Gather fruit in the garden without touching your tail.
snake.how: Swipe to turn. Avoid the walls, the rocks and your own body.

climb.name: Crystal Climb
climb.pitch: Bounce your way up the cave shaft.
climb.how: Drag left and right to steer. Avoid spiky platforms and watch out for crumbling ones.

rhythm.name: Music Lesson
rhythm.pitch: Tap when a crystal lands on its button.
rhythm.how: Tap the lane or press A/S/D as the crystal reaches the colored button. Speed rises over time!

fish.name: Calm Fishing
fish.pitch: Pull the rod at the right moment.
fish.how: Tap when a fish bites, then stop the needle inside the green zone. Three good pulls and it is yours.

castle.name: Castle Builder
castle.pitch: Stack the blocks and raise your castle tower.
castle.how: The block swings — tap to drop it. Any overhang is sliced off; a perfect drop earns a bonus.

apples.name: Apple Rain
apples.pitch: Move the basket and catch the ripe apples.
apples.how: Drag the basket. Apples are +10, golden apples +50. Rocks and worms cost you a life!

common.tap_to_start: Tap Start when you are ready

car.name: Country Road
car.pitch: Drive the car and dodge the traffic.
car.how: Swipe to change lane. Avoid cars, grab the fuel cans.

bird.name: Sparrow Flight
bird.pitch: Guide a little sparrow through the gaps between logs.
bird.how: Tap to flap. Don't hit the logs or the ground — every gap you pass scores.

festival.title: Village Festival
festival.desc: Play three random mini games in a row and add up your score.
festival.need_games: Unlock at least 3 mini games to join the festival.
festival.abandon_text: Your progress in this run will be lost.
festival.rules: Scores from each round are summed. Rewards are paid at the end.

farming.title: Garden Farm
farming.hint: Pick a seed, tap an empty plot to plant, tap a growing plant to water it, tap a ready crop to harvest.
farming.no_seed: You have no {name} seeds. Visit the shop!
farming.no_animals: No animals yet. Buy one in the shop!

shop.title: General Store
shop.nothing_sell: Nothing to sell yet. Harvest some crops first!
shop.decor_desc: A cozy touch for your room.
shop.skin_desc: A new look for your character. Bought outfits can also be worn at home.

inventory.title: Your House
inventory.no_decor: Buy decorations at the store to place them here.
inventory.buy_skins_hint: You can buy new looks in the Outfits section of the store.
inventory.name: Name

results.title: Results
results.festival_note: Festival rewards are paid at the end of the run.

errors.save_reset: Save data was damaged, so a fresh save was created.

tutorial.title: Quick tips
tutorial.move: Drag the stick on the left to walk around.
tutorial.act: Tap the A button near doors and villagers.
tutorial.quests: Check your quests every day for coins and seeds.

elder.l1: Welcome to our little village! Plant a seed at the farm and the day will grow with it.
elder.l2: The old stone square comes alive during the festival. Bring your best scores!
elder.l3: Quests renew every day. A patient villager always has a full pocket.

teacher.l1: Crystals fit best when you plan two moves ahead. Try it in my class!
teacher.l2: A tidy grid is a tidy mind. Clear a full row and feel the difference.
teacher.l3: Practice makes a new record. Come back and beat your best!

cafe_owner.l1: Cup first, then the rest. Guests hate waiting, so be quick!
cafe_owner.l2: My coffee is simple: cup, coffee, a little milk. Easy, right?
cafe_owner.l3: Wrong ingredient? No worries, just start the order again.

shepherd.l1: My sheep love sunny days. Buy one and you will get fresh wool.
shepherd.l2: Chickens lay eggs while you are away. Come back later and collect!
shepherd.l3: Watering a plant makes it grow faster. A little care goes a long way.

shopkeeper.l1: Seeds, lamps, rugs... if I do not have it, you probably do not need it!
shopkeeper.l2: You can sell your crops and eggs to me. Fair prices, I promise.
shopkeeper.l3: A new farm plot means more crops. Think about it!
